player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''The Ithorian''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
description: A 30-card deck designed to help you teach SWCCG to a new player.  It compliments the other training decks I submitted.
cards: posted: Bespin Motors Void Spider THX-1138
notes: Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 24 June 2001, before Coruscant, and the list has no Coruscant-set card.
No Objective; the deck starts the Death Star: Central Core (posted under 'Starting'), which counts toward the total.
A 30-card teaching deck by design (the description calls it 'a 30-card deck designed to help you teach SWCCG to a new player'); the total is 30 as published, not 60.
Posted '5D6-...' (name cut off) dested 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix), the only 5D6 card; posted 'Ket Kit'keek' dested Kitik Keed'kak (Dark Premiere Cantina character).
Posted 'Ponda Boba' dested Ponda Baba; 'Death Star Level 4 Corridor' dested Death Star: Level 4 Military Corridor; 'LIN-V8M' dested LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm).
Dark pages dested for the dual-printed Premiere cards: Tatooine: Cantina (Dark), Blaster Rifle (Dark), Restraining Bolt (Dark), Timer Mine (Dark).
The post says it is meant to be played against the author's Light Side training counterpart.
